title: 运动协调与整机动力学
Motion Coordination and Machine Dynamics
goals: Read the whole-machine timing diagram and the phase budget of one stitch, and state the order of the key instants (55°, 101.7°, 114.2°, 206°, 258.3°, 293°, 325.8°, 341°).
能列出跨机构的时序约束，解释旋梭、挑线、送布三个相位窗口的大小和两端的限制原因，以及设计时确定相位的顺序。
List the cross-mechanism timing constraints, explain the size and limiting causes of the hook, take-up and feed phase windows, and the order in which phases are fixed in design.
能用惯性力与转速平方成正比的关系计算转速变化后的振动力，并解释平衡率 k 的取舍。
Use the square-law between inertia force and speed to compute shaking force after a speed change, and explain the choice of balance ratio k.
能说明振动噪声的控制途径、润滑方式与旋梭油量检查方法，以及决定转速上限的因素。
Explain how vibration and noise are controlled, how the machine is lubricated and hook oil checked, and what limits the top speed.

title: 提速 20%，机头抖起来了
20% faster, and the head starts to shake
text: 某衬衫厂为了赶单，想把一条线的标准平缝机从 5000 r/min 提到 6000 r/min。按本章的示意质量，平衡率 k = 0.45 时，整机惯性力最大合力在 5000 r/min 下约 368 N；第 3 章算过针杆在下止点的惯性力约 654 N。机针在布中与送布牙抓布的重叠区为 101.7°–114.2°。该机型使用说明书给出的标准型最高转速为 5500 sti/min。

To meet an order, a shirt factory wants to raise a line of standard lockstitch machines from 5000 to 6000 r/min. With this chapter’s illustrative masses and a balance ratio k = 0.45, the maximum resultant inertia force at 5000 r/min is about 368 N; Chapter 3 found the needle-bar inertia force at bottom dead centre to be about 654 N. The needle-in-fabric and feed-dog gripping intervals overlap from 101.7° to 114.2°. The manual gives a maximum speed of 5500 sti/min for the standard type.
question: 提到 6000 r/min 后，最大合力和针杆下止点惯性力各变为多少？重叠区的时间从多少变到多少？你建议把转速定在多少，此时最大合力约为多少？
At 6000 r/min, what do the maximum resultant and the needle-bar force at BDC become? How does the time of the overlap change? What speed would you recommend, and what is the maximum resultant there?
answer: 惯性力与转速平方成正比，(6000/5000)² = 1.44：最大合力约 368 × 1.44 ≈ 530 N，针杆下止点约 654 × 1.44 ≈ 942 N。12.5° 的重叠区在 5000 r/min 时为 0.42 ms，6000 r/min 时缩短到约 0.35 ms，相位余量按时间计变紧。6000 r/min 已超过说明书标准型最高转速 5500 sti/min，不宜长时间运转；建议不超过 5500 r/min，此时 (5500/5000)² = 1.21，最大合力约 445 N，针杆下止点约 791 N。产量的提升应靠减少停机、改善工序平衡，而不是越过机器的设计转速。

Inertia force goes with the square of speed, (6000/5000)² = 1.44: the maximum resultant becomes about 368 × 1.44 ≈ 530 N and the needle-bar force at BDC about 654 × 1.44 ≈ 942 N. The 12.5° overlap lasts 0.42 ms at 5000 r/min and only about 0.35 ms at 6000 r/min, so the timing margin shrinks in time. 6000 r/min is above the manual’s 5500 sti/min for the standard type and should not be run for long; keep to 5500 r/min or less, where (5500/5000)² = 1.21 gives a maximum resultant of about 445 N and a needle-bar force of about 791 N. Output should be raised by cutting downtime and balancing operations, not by exceeding the machine’s design speed.

title: 相位预算与平衡 ↔ 压力机上下料机器人
Phase budget and balancing ↔ a press-tending robot
text: 冲压线上的上下料机器人和平缝机的送布一样，只能在压力机滑块抬起、模具打开的那一段相位里伸进去取放工件，滑块下行之前必须退出：这就是“机针在布外才能送布”的翻版。控制上，机器人用压力机曲轴的编码器做主轴，按电子凸轮跟随它，并设置互锁窗口，正像全机时序图里每个机构都挂在同一根主轴的转角上。压力机节拍从每分钟 15 次提到 18 次，同样的轨迹形状下机器人各轴加速度和惯性力增大到 (18/15)² = 1.44 倍，和缝纫机提速的平方律一样。大型工业机器人第 2 轴常装弹簧或气缸平衡器抵消大臂重力矩，作用与针杆曲柄对面的平衡块相似：只能抵消一部分，选多大要权衡。

A robot loading and unloading a press is like the feed of a lockstitch machine: it may reach in to place or remove a part only during the phase when the ram is up and the die open, and must be out before the ram descends — the counterpart of “feed only while the needle is out”. In control terms the robot uses the press crankshaft encoder as its main shaft, follows it with an electronic cam and sets interlock windows, just as every mechanism in the whole-machine timing diagram hangs on one shaft angle. Raise the press from 15 to 18 strokes a minute, and with the same path shape the robot’s axis accelerations and inertia forces grow by (18/15)² = 1.44 — the same square law as speeding up a sewing machine. Large industrial robots often carry a spring or gas balancer on axis 2 to offset the gravity moment of the upper arm, much like the counterweight opposite the needle-bar crank: it cancels only part of the load, and its size is a trade-off.

title: 洗衣机甩干时“走路”
A washing machine walking during the spin
text: 衣服在滚筒里堆到一边，甩干时洗衣机会剧烈抖动甚至“走路”：不平衡的离心力与转速平方成正比。所以洗衣机甩干前会先低速转几圈把衣服摊匀（相当于选好平衡），检测到不平衡时还会自动降速。

When the laundry bunches to one side, a washing machine shakes hard or even “walks” during the spin: the unbalanced centrifugal force grows with the square of speed. So it first turns slowly to spread the load (choosing the balance), and slows down automatically when it detects imbalance.

title: 引子：牵一发而动全身
Opening: pull one thread and the whole machine moves
points: 针织物跳针，旋梭往后调了七八度，跳针少了，却开始断面线。
Knit fabric skips; the hook is retarded seven or eight degrees; skips fall but the needle thread starts breaking.
转速从 4000 提到 5000 r/min，机头发抖、台板嗡嗡响。
Speed raised from 4000 to 5000 r/min: the head shakes and the table hums.
前者：旋梭定时还牵涉挑线杆放的线够不够线环用（第 4 章）。
The first: hook timing also governs whether the take-up releases enough thread for the loop (Chapter 4).
后者：惯性力与转速平方成正比，提速 25% 惯性力变为 1.56 倍。
The second: inertia force goes with speed squared; 25% faster means 1.56 times the force.
narration: 第 3 到第 7 章，我们一章讲一个机构。可在机器上，它们都挂在同一根主轴上，由同一个电机带着转。车间里常有这样的事：一台机器缝针织物跳针，师傅把旋梭往后调了七八度，跳针少了，没多久开始断面线；另一台机器从 4000 转提到 5000 转，机头发抖，台板嗡嗡响，旁边的人说话都得提高嗓门。前一件说明，旋梭定时不只关系到钩线，还关系到挑线杆放的线够不够线环用；后一件说明，惯性力是全体零件共同产生的，转速提高 25%，惯性力就变成 1.56 倍。这一讲就是把各机构放到一起看。

From Chapter 3 to Chapter 7 we took one mechanism per chapter. But on the machine they all hang on the same main shaft and are driven by the same motor. Things like this happen all the time: a machine skips on knits, the mechanic retards the hook seven or eight degrees, the skips fall, and soon the needle thread starts breaking. Another machine goes from 4000 to 5000 r/min, the head shakes, the table hums, and people nearby have to raise their voices. The first case shows that hook timing affects not just loop catching but also whether the take-up lever releases enough thread for the loop. The second shows that inertia force is produced by all the parts together, and 25% more speed means 1.56 times the force. This lesson looks at the mechanisms together.

title: 全机时序图
The whole-machine timing diagram
points: 第 3–7 章的算例画在同一根转角轴上：针尖高度、供线量与耗线量、梭尖转角、送布牙高度与水平位置、面线张力。
Chapters 3–7 on one angle axis: needle-point height, thread supply and consumption, hook angle, feed-dog height and position, needle tension.
灰色为机针在布中；竖虚线为一针中的关键时刻。
Grey shading: needle in the fabric; vertical dashed lines: the key instants of a stitch.
任何机构的定时变化，都要回到这张图上检查别的机构。
Any timing change must be checked against the other mechanisms on this chart.
narration: 看图 8-1，这是把第 3 到第 7 章的算例画在同一根转角轴上的全机时序图。最上面是针尖高度；往下是挑线机构的供线量和线环的耗线量，紫色实线减橙色虚线就是余线；再往下是梭尖转角，阴影段是梭尖带着线环；然后是送布牙的高度和水平位置；最下面是面线张力的示意曲线。灰色底纹是机针在布中，竖着的虚线是一针中的关键时刻。这张图的意义在于：以前各章各算各的，现在它们共用一根横轴。动了任何一个机构的定时，都要回到这张图上，看它有没有撞上别的机构。

Look at Fig. 8-1: the worked examples of Chapters 3 to 7 drawn on one shaft-angle axis — the whole-machine timing diagram. At the top is the needle-point height; below it the thread supplied by the take-up and consumed by the loop, the purple solid line minus the orange dashed line being the slack; then the hook-point angle, with the shaded band where the hook carries the loop; then the feed-dog height and horizontal position; and at the bottom an illustrative needle-tension curve. Grey shading is the needle in the fabric, and the dashed verticals are the key instants of a stitch. The point of the chart is that the chapters, each calculated separately, now share one horizontal axis. Change the timing of any mechanism and you must come back here to see whether it now collides with another.

title: 一针按顺序走一遍
One stitch, in order
points: 0° 针杆上止点；55° 挑线杆收线最紧，线迹收紧，同时从夹线器拉线。
0° needle bar at TDC; 55° take-up tightest, the stitch is set and thread drawn from the tension assembly.
101.7° 针尖入布；114.2° 针眼上沿到针板，送布牙同时落下；180° 下止点。
101.7° needle enters; 114.2° eye top at the plate and the dog drops; 180° BDC.
206° 梭尖钩线；258.3° 针尖出布；293° 挑线杆放线最多。
206° hook catches the loop; 258.3° needle leaves; 293° maximum thread release.
325.8° 送布牙升出开始推布；341° 前后脱环，挑线杆随即收紧，进入下一针。
325.8° dog emerges and starts feeding; about 341° cast-off, and the take-up pulls tight for the next stitch.
narration: 我们把关键时刻按顺序走一遍，一针的过程就清楚了。0 度针杆在上止点。55 度挑线杆收线最紧，线迹在这一刻前后被收紧，同时从夹线器拉出下一针要用的线。101.7 度针尖刺进布，114.2 度针眼上沿到达针板面，送布牙同时落下，这是第 6 章的标准定时。180 度针杆到下止点，回升约 2 毫米后，206 度梭尖钩住线环。258.3 度针尖离开布料。293 度挑线杆放线最多，线环正在绕过梭壳。325.8 度送布牙升出针板开始推布。341 度前后线环脱出，挑线杆迅速把它收紧，进入下一针。

Let’s walk through the key instants in order, and the course of a stitch becomes clear. At 0° the needle bar is at top dead centre. At 55° the take-up lever is at its tightest: the stitch is set around this moment, and thread for the next stitch is drawn from the tension assembly. At 101.7° the needle point enters the fabric; at 114.2° the top of the eye reaches the plate and the feed dog drops — Chapter 6’s standard timing. At 180° the bar is at bottom dead centre; after rising about 2 mm, the hook catches the loop at 206°. At 258.3° the needle leaves the fabric. At 293° the take-up has released the most thread, while the loop passes round the bobbin case. At 325.8° the dog emerges and starts to feed. Around 341° the loop is cast off, and the take-up pulls it tight, beginning the next stitch.

title: 一针的“相位预算”
The phase budget of one stitch
points: 由外到内：机针在布中、梭尖带线环、挑线杆放线与收线、送布牙抓布。
From outside in: needle in fabric, hook carrying the loop, take-up releasing and taking up, dog gripping.
机针在布中与牙抓布几乎首尾相接，只重叠 12.5°（101.7°–114.2°），5000 r/min 下仅 0.42 ms；这时牙的水平运动已基本走完。
Needle-in and dog-gripping almost meet end to end, overlapping only 12.5° (101.7°–114.2°), just 0.42 ms at 5000 r/min; by then the dog’s horizontal motion is essentially done.
梭尖带线环的 135°（206°–341°）跨过机针出布；脱环后才能收紧。
The hook’s 135° with the loop (206°–341°) spans the needle’s exit; only after cast-off can the stitch be set.
55° 收线最紧时送布牙还在推布：线迹在布移动时被收紧。
At the 55° take-up the dog is still feeding: the stitch is set while the fabric moves.
narration: 教材把一针画成一个圆盘，图 8-2。最外圈是机针在布中，往里依次是梭尖带着线环、挑线杆放线和收线、送布牙抓布。圆盘上最清楚的是三件事。第一，机针在布中和送布牙抓布几乎首尾相接，只在 101.7 到 114.2 度重叠 12.5 度，5000 转下只有 0.42 毫秒，好在这时牙的水平运动已经基本走完。第二，梭尖带着线环的 135 度从 206 到 341 度，跨过了机针出布，脱环后挑线杆才能收紧。第三，挑线杆 55 度收线最紧时，送布牙还在推布。相位一动，就要回圆盘上检查。

To see how the mechanisms share the 360°, the book draws one stitch as a disc, Fig. 8-2. The outer ring is the needle in the fabric; inward come the hook carrying the loop, the take-up releasing and taking up, and the dog gripping. Three things stand out. First, needle-in and dog-gripping almost meet end to end, overlapping only 12.5° from 101.7° to 114.2° — just 0.42 ms at 5000 r/min — and luckily by then the dog’s horizontal motion is essentially finished. Second, the hook’s 135° with the loop, from 206° to 341°, spans the needle’s exit, and only after cast-off can the take-up set the stitch. Third, when the take-up is tightest at 55°, the dog is still feeding. Move any phase and you must come back to the disc and check.

title: 跨机构的时序约束
Cross-mechanism timing constraints
points: 旋梭：钩线时回升 1.6–2.5 mm（借用手册范围，对应 203.2°–209.2°）。
Hook: rise at catch 1.6–2.5 mm (manual range borrowed, i.e. 203.2°–209.2°).
挑线（余线从 55° 算起）：针眼入布（约 109°）前余线 ≤ 挑线簧行程 10 mm；入布后到钩线欠线 ≤ 1 mm；钩线到脱环余量 ≥ 1 mm。
Take-up (slack from 55°): before eye entry (about 109°) slack ≤ 10 mm check-spring stroke; from entry to catch, shortfall ≤ 1 mm; catch to cast-off margin ≥ 1 mm.
送布：布在针中移动 ≤ 0.05 mm；升牙至少比针尖出布晚 20°（示意）。
Feed: fabric movement with the needle in ≤ 0.05 mm; dog rises at least 20° after the needle leaves (illustrative).
钩线时刻同时决定线环何时大量要线，所以旋梭与挑线是联动的。
Catch timing also sets when the loop starts demanding thread, so hook and take-up are coupled.
narration: 前几章的判据放到一起，就是一组跨机构约束，虚拟实验 8-1 右边实时检查的就是这六条。旋梭：钩线时机针回升要在 1.6 到 2.5 毫米之间，对应主轴 203.2 到 209.2 度。挑线有三条，余线都从收线最紧的 55 度算起：针眼入布前余线不能超过挑线簧行程 10 毫米；针眼入布以后到钩线以前，欠线不超过 1 毫米；钩线到脱环，余量不少于 1 毫米。送布两条：布在针中移动不超过 0.05 毫米，升牙至少比针尖出布晚 20 度。钩线时刻也决定线环何时大量要线，所以旋梭和挑线是联动的。

The previous chapters each gave their own criteria; together they form a set of cross-mechanism constraints, and these six are what Virtual lab 8-1 checks live on the right. Hook: the needle rise at catch must be 1.6 to 2.5 mm, which is 203.2° to 209.2° of shaft. Take-up has three, all counting slack from the tightest point at 55°: before the eye enters the fabric, the slack released early must not exceed the 10 mm check-spring stroke, or it cannot be held; from eye entry to catch, the shortfall must not exceed 1 mm; and from catch to cast-off the margin must be at least 1 mm. Feed has two: the fabric moves no more than 0.05 mm with the needle in, and the dog rises at least 20° after the needle leaves. The key point: catch timing also decides when the loop starts demanding thread, so hook and take-up are coupled.

title: 三个机构的相位窗口
Phase windows of the three mechanisms
points: 单独移动一个、其余保持标准，算出可用窗口。
Move one at a time, keep the others standard, and find the usable window.
旋梭约 −2.8° 到 +3.2°，两头都由回升量限制；只看挑线余量，要推迟约 6.5° 才降到 1 mm 以下，每推迟 1° 余量少约 0.1–0.2 mm。
Hook about −2.8° to +3.2°, both ends set by the rise; on take-up margin alone it would take about 6.5° of retard to drop below 1 mm, losing about 0.1–0.2 mm per degree.
挑线约 −3° 到 +6°：提前则入布前余线超 10 mm，推迟则入布后欠线超 1 mm（+7° 时 1.13 mm）。
Take-up about −3° to +6°: advanced, the slack before entry exceeds 10 mm; retarded, the shortfall after entry exceeds 1 mm (1.13 mm at +7°).
送布很不对称：推迟只能约 +1°（标准已在 0.04 mm），提前可到 −47°。
Feed is very asymmetric: only about +1° of retard (standard already at 0.04 mm), but up to −47° of advance.
narration: 三个机构分别单独移动，就得到图 8-3 的三个窗口。旋梭定时约负 2.8 到正 3.2 度，两头都是回升量先出界。如果只看挑线余量，要推迟约 6.5 度余量才降到 1 毫米以下，所以钩线本身先受限，但每推迟 1 度挑线余量就少 0.1 到 0.2 毫米。开头那位师傅推迟了七八度，正好把挑线余量用光，于是断线。挑线相位约负 3 到正 6 度，两头原因不同：提前了入布前余线超过挑线簧行程，推迟了入布后欠线超过 1 毫米。送布最不对称，推迟只能 1 度左右，提前却能到 47 度。

Move the phase of each mechanism in turn, others at standard, and you get the three windows of Fig. 8-3. Hook timing runs from about minus 2.8 to plus 3.2 degrees, both ends set by the rise going out of range. On take-up margin alone, it would take about 6.5° of retard to drop below 1 mm, so on this machine catching is limited first and the take-up keeps a little reserve — but each degree of retard costs 0.1 to 0.2 mm. The mechanic in the opening retarded seven or eight degrees, used up exactly that reserve, and the thread broke. The take-up phase runs from about minus 3 to plus 6, with different causes: advanced, the slack before entry exceeds the check-spring stroke; retarded, the shortfall after entry exceeds 1 mm. Feed is the most lopsided: only about 1° of retard, but up to 47° of advance.

title: 读窗口：现场与设计
Reading the windows: field and design
points: 挑线曲柄安装角在设计时定死，现场不调；窗口告诉设计者相位误差要控制在几度以内。
The take-up crank angle is fixed in design, not adjusted in the field; the window tells designers to hold its error within a few degrees.
送布窗口呼应说明书：为防送布不匀，可把送布定时提前。
The feed window matches the manual: advance the feed timing to prevent uneven feeding.
设计定相位的顺序：刺布（基准）→ 按回升量定钩线 → 按钩线与耗线量设计挑线 → 在机针出布的空档里安排送布。
Design order: needle bar (reference) → catch from the rise → take-up from catch and loop consumption → feed in the gap while the needle is out.
顺序反过来，前面定好的就要返工。
Reverse the order and earlier decisions must be redone.
narration: 这三个窗口对现场和设计各有意义。挑线曲柄的安装角在真实机器上是设计时定死的，现场不调，所以挑线窗口是给设计者看的：挑线机构的相位误差要控制在几度以内。送布窗口推迟只有 1 度、提前有 47 度，正好呼应了说明书那句话：为了防止送布不匀，可以把送布定时提前。窗口还说明了设计时确定相位的顺序：先定刺布机构，它是一切定时的基准；再按回升量定钩线时刻；再按钩线时刻和线环的耗线量设计挑线机构；最后在机针出布的空档里安排送布。顺序倒过来，前面定好的东西就得返工。

The three windows matter both in the field and in design. On a real machine the take-up crank angle is fixed at the design stage and not adjusted in the field, so the take-up window is a message to designers: the take-up phase error must be held within a few degrees. The feed window — only about 1° of retard but 47° of advance — matches the manual’s advice that feed timing may be advanced to prevent uneven feeding. The windows also show the order in which phases are fixed in design: first the needle-bar mechanism, the reference for all timing; then the catch instant from the needle rise; then the take-up mechanism from the catch instant and the loop’s thread consumption; and finally the feed, fitted into the gap while the needle is out. Work in reverse and what was fixed earlier has to be redone.

title: 整机惯性力从哪里来
Where the machine’s inertia forces come from
points: 针杆往复（第 3 章：5000 r/min 下止点约 654 N）；曲柄、曲柄销、连杆大头随主轴旋转。
Needle-bar reciprocation (Chapter 3: about 654 N at BDC at 5000 r/min); crank, pin and big end rotating with the shaft.
挑线杆复杂平面运动；送布牙架前后、上下往复。
Take-up lever in complex plane motion; feed-dog carrier reciprocating fore-aft and up-down.
示意质量：针杆 120 g、曲柄旋转部分 60 g、挑线杆 25 g（质心在 45% 处）、牙架 50 g。
Illustrative masses: needle bar 120 g, rotating crank 60 g, take-up lever 25 g (CoM at 45%), feed carrier 50 g.
挑线杆虽轻，质心加速度最大约 10.7 km/s²，惯性力可达约 270 N，不能忽略。
The take-up lever is light, but its CoM acceleration peaks at about 10.7 km/s², giving about 270 N — not negligible.
narration: 下面转到动力学。第 3 章算过，针杆的往复惯性力在 5000 转时，下止点约 654 牛。产生惯性力的还有：针杆曲柄、曲柄销和连杆大头随主轴旋转；挑线杆做复杂的平面运动；送布牙架前后、上下往复。教材取了一组示意质量：针杆往复部分 120 克，曲柄旋转部分 60 克，挑线杆 25 克，质心在曲柄销到线孔的 45% 处，送布牙架 50 克。挑线杆才 25 克，能不管吗？第 4 章的连杆式挑线机构运动非常剧烈，质心加速度最大约每二次方秒 10.7 千米，惯性力能到 270 牛左右，不能忽略。

Now to dynamics. Chapter 3 found the needle bar’s reciprocating inertia force at 5000 r/min to be about 654 N at bottom dead centre. Several other parts produce inertia forces too: the needle-bar crank, crank pin and big end of the rod rotate with the shaft; the take-up lever moves in a complex plane motion; and the feed-dog carrier reciprocates fore-and-aft and up-and-down. The book takes illustrative masses: 120 g reciprocating in the needle bar, 60 g rotating in the crank, 25 g for the take-up lever with its centre of mass 45% of the way from crank pin to thread hole, and 50 g for the feed carrier. You might think a 25 g take-up lever can be ignored. But the link-type take-up of Chapter 4 moves violently: its centre of mass peaks at about 10.7 km/s², and its inertia force reaches around 270 N — certainly not negligible.

title: 平衡块与平衡率 k
The counterweight and balance ratio k
points: 平衡块在针杆曲柄对面，离心力与曲柄销同频反向。
The counterweight sits opposite the crank; its centrifugal force has the same frequency and opposite direction.
平衡块 = 旋转质量 + k × 往复质量；k = 0 只平衡旋转部分。
Counterweight = rotating mass + k × reciprocating mass; k = 0 balances only the rotating part.
k = 1 把往复质量的一阶力在竖直方向全部抵消，却在水平方向产生同样大小的新不平衡力。
k = 1 cancels the whole first-order reciprocating force vertically but creates an equal new one horizontally.
5000 r/min：k = 0 最大合力约 582 N（偏竖直），k = 1 约 609 N（偏水平），k = 0.45 约 368 N（轨迹最接近圆）。
At 5000 r/min: k = 0 about 582 N (mostly vertical), k = 1 about 609 N (mostly horizontal), k = 0.45 about 368 N (locus nearest a circle).
narration: 针杆曲柄对面有一块平衡块，它的离心力和曲柄销同频率、方向相反。它应当全部抵消旋转质量的离心力，再抵消一部分往复质量的一阶力。教材把平衡块写成旋转质量加 k 乘往复质量，k 叫平衡率。k 等于 0 只平衡旋转部分；k 等于 1 把往复质量的一阶力在竖直方向全部抵消，可代价是在水平方向冒出一个同样大的新不平衡力。看图 8-4 右边合力矢量的轨迹：k 等于 0 竖直拉长，最大约 582 牛；k 等于 1 变成水平拉长，约 609 牛；k 等于 0.45 时最接近一个圆，最大降到约 368 牛。

Opposite the needle-bar crank sits a counterweight whose centrifugal force has the same frequency as the crank pin’s and acts the opposite way. Following Chapter 3, it should cancel all the centrifugal force of the rotating mass plus part of the first-order force of the reciprocating mass. The book writes the counterweight as the rotating mass plus k times the reciprocating mass, k being the balance ratio. k = 0 balances only the rotating part; k = 1 cancels the whole first-order reciprocating force vertically, but at the price of an equally large new unbalanced force horizontally. Look at the loci of the resultant on the right of Fig. 8-4: at k = 0 it is stretched vertically with a maximum of about 582 N; at k = 1 it is stretched horizontally, about 609 N; at k = 0.45 it is closest to a circle and the maximum falls to about 368 N.

title: 最佳平衡率与谐波
The best balance ratio and harmonics
points: 最好的 k 约 0.45；只算针杆和曲柄约 0.6，加上挑线杆后降低——挑线杆的一阶分量偏水平。
The best k is about 0.45; needle bar and crank alone give about 0.6, and adding the take-up lowers it — its first-order component leans horizontal.
k = 0.45 时竖直一阶约 234 N、二阶约 119 N；水平一阶约 338 N；三、四阶几十牛以下。
At k = 0.45: vertical first order about 234 N, second about 119 N; horizontal first about 338 N; third and fourth below a few tens of newtons.
竖直二阶主要来自针杆（λ cos 2φ 项），曲柄上的平衡块无能为力。
The vertical second order comes mainly from the needle bar (the λ cos 2φ term); a crank counterweight cannot touch it.
Inertia force ∝ speed²: at k = 0.45, maximum resultant about 236, 368 and 530 N at 4000, 5000 and 6000 r/min.
narration: 图 8-5 左边是最大合力随平衡率的变化，最好的 k 约 0.45。如果只算针杆和曲柄，最佳 k 约 0.6；加上挑线杆以后降到 0.45 左右。原因是挑线杆惯性力的一阶分量偏在水平方向，平衡块再多就把更多的力往水平方向转，得不偿失。右边是 k 等于 0.45 时的谐波：竖直一阶约 234 牛、二阶约 119 牛，水平一阶约 338 牛，三阶四阶都只有几十牛。竖直二阶主要来自针杆，即第 3 章的 λ cos2φ 项，频率是转速的两倍，曲柄上的平衡块管不着。最后记住：所有惯性力都与转速平方成正比。

The left of Fig. 8-5 shows the maximum resultant against the balance ratio: the best k is about 0.45. Interestingly, counting only the needle bar and crank the optimum is about 0.6; adding the take-up lever lowers it to around 0.45. The reason is that the take-up’s first-order force leans horizontal, so more counterweight just turns more force into the horizontal direction — more harm than good. On the right are the harmonics at k = 0.45: vertical first order about 234 N, second order about 119 N, horizontal first order about 338 N, and third and fourth orders only a few tens of newtons. The vertical second order comes mainly from the needle bar — the λ cos 2φ term of Chapter 3 — at twice the shaft frequency, and a counterweight on the crank simply cannot reach it. And remember: all inertia forces go with the square of the speed.

title: 振动与噪声
Vibration and noise
points: 惯性力 → 轴承 → 机壳 → 台板、机架：振动；机壳和台板向空气辐射：噪声。
Inertia force → bearings → housing → table and stand: vibration; housing and table radiate into the air: noise.
三条路：减轻运动零件（空心针杆、轻量化挑线杆）、选好平衡块、机头与台板之间加弹性垫。
Three routes: lighter moving parts (hollow needle bar, light take-up), a well-chosen counterweight, elastic pads between head and table.
前两条从源头减小惯性力，第三条阻断传递路径。
The first two cut the force at the source; the third breaks the transmission path.
噪声按国际标准给出：某标准平缝机 5000 sti/min 下工位 A 计权声压级 83.5 dB（ISO 10821、ISO 11204）；几十台同开就是劳动保护问题。
Noise is stated to international standards: one standard machine at 5000 sti/min, 83.5 dB A-weighted at the workstation (ISO 10821, ISO 11204); dozens together make it an occupational-health issue.
narration: 惯性力经过轴承传到机壳，再从机壳传到台板和机架，引起振动；振动的机壳和台板向空气辐射声音，就是噪声。降低振动有三条路：一是减轻运动零件的质量，比如空心针杆、轻量化挑线杆；二是选好平衡块，就是刚才讲的平衡率；三是在机头和台板之间装弹性垫，减少传到台板上的振动。前两条是从源头减小惯性力，第三条是阻断传递路径。噪声是工业缝纫机的重要指标，说明书按国际标准测定给出，某标准平缝机在 5000 针每分钟下工位声压级 83.5 分贝。一个车间几十台同时开，噪声控制就成了劳动保护问题。

Inertia forces pass through the bearings into the housing, then from the housing to the table and stand, causing vibration; the vibrating housing and table radiate sound into the air — noise. There are three ways to reduce vibration: first, lighten the moving parts, such as a hollow needle bar or a lightweight take-up lever; second, choose the counterweight well — the balance ratio we just discussed; third, fit elastic pads between the head and the table to cut what reaches the table. The first two reduce the force at the source; the third breaks the transmission path. Noise is an important specification, and manuals state it measured to international standards: one standard lockstitch machine at 5000 stitches a minute gives 83.5 dB at the workstation. With dozens running in one workshop, noise control becomes an occupational-health matter.

title: 润滑
Lubrication
points: 摩擦副：上下轴轴承、针杆与针杆套、挑线与连杆铰链、两倍转速的旋梭。
Friction pairs: shaft bearings, needle bar and bushing, take-up and link joints, and the hook at twice shaft speed.
集中润滑：底板下油盘，下轴带油泵，经油路送到旋梭和各轴承，余油流回。
Centralised lubrication: oil pan under the bed, a pump driven by the hook shaft sends oil to the hook and bearings, surplus drains back.
旋梭油量单独调：停机后立即用油量检查纸看油迹宽度，薄料型约 0.5–1 mm，中厚、厚料型约 1–3 mm。
Hook oil is set separately: right after stopping, check the splash width on oil-check paper — about 0.5–1 mm for light, 1–3 mm for medium and heavy types.
布料沾油最怕：新一代机型用半干式或微量润滑，伺服直驱主轴（如 400 W），取消皮带离合器。
Oil on fabric is dreaded: new machines use semi-dry or minimum-quantity lubrication with direct servo drive (e.g. 400 W), dropping belt and clutch.
narration: 平缝机里有许多高速、交变载荷的摩擦副：上下轴的轴承、针杆和针杆套、挑线机构和连杆的铰链，还有转速是主轴两倍的旋梭。传统做法是集中润滑，看图 8-6：底板下面一个油盘，下轴带动小油泵，把油经油路送到旋梭和各处轴承，多余的油流回油盘。旋梭的油量要单独调：油多了甩到布上，油少了发热磨损。说明书的检查方法：停机后立刻把油量检查纸放在旋梭下方，看油迹宽度，薄料型约 0.5 到 1 毫米，中厚和厚料型约 1 到 3 毫米。布料沾油是服装厂最怕的，所以新机型多用半干式或微量润滑，再加伺服直驱。

A lockstitch machine has many friction pairs running fast under alternating loads: the shaft bearings, the needle bar and its bushing, the joints of the take-up and links, and the hook at twice shaft speed. The traditional answer is centralised lubrication — see Fig. 8-6: an oil pan under the bed, a small pump driven by the hook shaft sending oil through passages to the hook and bearings, and surplus draining back. Hook oil is adjusted separately: too much flings onto the fabric, too little heats and wears the hook. The manual’s check is practical: immediately after stopping, hold oil-check paper under the hook and look at the width of the splash — about 0.5 to 1 mm for light-material types, 1 to 3 mm for medium and heavy. Oily fabric is what garment factories dread most, so new machines use semi-dry or minimum-quantity lubrication with direct servo drive.

title: 转速的上限
The upper limit on speed
points: 取决于最先到达极限的机构：针杆惯性力（654 N）、挑线杆线孔加速度（约 30 km/s²）、梭尖速度（约 14 m/s）、针热、整机振动噪声、润滑。
Set by whichever limit is reached first: needle-bar force (654 N), take-up eye acceleration (about 30 km/s²), hook speed (about 14 m/s), needle heat, machine vibration and noise, lubrication.
说明书：标准型 5500 sti/min；薄料、中厚料、厚料型 4000 sti/min；厚料型针距 > 5 mm 降到 3200 sti/min。
Manual: standard type 5500 sti/min; light, medium and heavy types 4000 sti/min; heavy type with stitches over 5 mm, 3200 sti/min.
薄料型也比标准型低：限制不只来自布厚，具体原因要看设计资料。
The light type is also slower than standard: the limit is not just fabric thickness; reasons lie in design data.
厚料大针距最低（本书解读）：粗针粗线、更大张力、针热多；针距大，牙行程与加速度大。
Heavy material with long stitches is slowest (the book’s interpretation): thick needle and thread, more tension and heat; long stitches mean bigger dog stroke and acceleration.
narration: 一台平缝机能跑多快，取决于最先到达极限的那个机构。前几章已经给出了各自的极限：针杆的惯性力，5000 转时下止点约 654 牛；挑线杆线孔加速度，连杆式约每二次方秒 30 千米，决定面线的动态张力；梭尖速度约 14 米每秒，决定线和梭摩擦发热；机针在布里摩擦发热会烫软合成纤维线；再加上本章的整机振动、噪声和润滑。说明书给的最高转速随机型不同：标准型 5500，薄料、中厚料、厚料型都是 4000，厚料型针距大于 5 毫米降到 3200。厚料大针距最低，一部分原因可以从前几章找到，这是本书的解读。

How fast a lockstitch machine can run depends on whichever mechanism reaches its limit first. Earlier chapters gave the individual limits: the needle-bar inertia force, about 654 N at BDC at 5000 r/min; the take-up eye acceleration, about 30 km/s² for the link type, which sets the dynamic tension in the needle thread; the hook-point speed, about 14 m/s, which governs frictional heating between thread and hook; needle heating in the fabric, which softens synthetic thread; and now the machine’s vibration, noise and lubrication. The manual’s top speed depends on the type: 5500 for standard; 4000 for light, medium and heavy types; 3200 for the heavy type above a 5 mm stitch. Heavy material at long stitches is slowest, and part of the reason can be found in earlier chapters — that is the book’s interpretation.

title: 模型的边界与现场要点
Limits of the model and shop-floor notes
points: 窗口是“其余保持标准、单独移动一个”得到的；几个量一起变，窗口形状也变（旋梭推迟时挑线也推迟，余量可保持）。
Windows assume one mechanism moved with others at standard; move several together and the windows change (retard take-up with the hook and the margin can be kept).
质量为示意值；只算合力不算力矩：挑线杆在面板侧、牙架在底板下，形成摇晃机头的力偶，平衡块抵消不了；未计旋梭、转动惯量、弹性与共振。

Masses are illustrative; resultant only, no moments: take-up on the face side and feed carrier under the bed make couples that rock the head, which the counterweight cannot cancel; hook, rotary inertia, elasticity and resonance are omitted.
调了旋梭顺手查挑线（断线、浮线）；调了送布查拖针和针距。
After adjusting the hook, check the take-up (breaks, loops); after adjusting the feed, check needle drag and stitch length.
振动突增先查平衡块和针杆曲柄螺钉，再查轴承皮带；不要长时间超过说明书最高转速。
If vibration suddenly rises, check counterweight and crank screws, then bearings and belt; don’t run above the manual’s top speed for long.
narration: 最后说模型的边界。本讲的时序窗口是“其余机构保持标准、单独移动一个”得到的，实际调机常常几个量一起变，窗口形状也会变，比如旋梭推迟时把挑线也推迟，余量可以保持。惯性力用的是示意质量，而且只算了合力没算力矩：挑线杆在面板一侧，送布牙架在底板下面，它们的力作用在不同位置，会形成使机头摇晃的力偶，曲柄上的平衡块抵消不了；旋梭、转动惯量、轴和机壳的弹性也没计入，接近共振时还要实测和有限元分析。现场要点：调了旋梭查挑线；调了送布查拖针；振动突然变大先查平衡块螺钉；别长时间超速。

Finally, the limits of the model. The timing windows here were found by moving one mechanism with the others at standard; in real adjustment several quantities often change together and the windows change shape — retard the take-up along with the hook, for instance, and the margin can be kept. The inertia forces use illustrative masses and only the resultant, not the moments: the take-up lever is on the face-plate side and the feed carrier under the bed, so their forces act at different places and create couples that rock the head, which the crank counterweight cannot cancel. The hook, rotary inertia and the elasticity of shafts and housing are also left out; near resonance, measurement and finite-element analysis are needed. Shop-floor notes: after adjusting the hook, check the take-up; after the feed, check needle drag; if vibration jumps, check the counterweight screws first; and don’t overspeed for long.

summary: 各机构挂在同一根主轴上：一针的关键时刻依次为 55° 收紧、101.7° 入布、114.2° 落牙、206° 钩线、258.3° 出布、293° 放线最多、325.8° 升牙、341° 脱环。
All mechanisms hang on one shaft: the key instants are 55° take-up tightest, 101.7° entry, 114.2° dog drops, 206° catch, 258.3° exit, 293° maximum release, 325.8° dog rises, 341° cast-off.
跨机构约束给出相位窗口：旋梭约 −2.8° 到 +3.2°，挑线约 −3° 到 +6°，送布推迟约 1°、提前可到 −47°；旋梭与挑线是联动的。
Cross-mechanism constraints give phase windows: hook about −2.8° to +3.2°, take-up about −3° to +6°, feed about 1° retard and up to −47° advance; hook and take-up are coupled.
设计定相位的顺序：刺布 → 钩线 → 挑线 → 送布。
The design order for phases: needle bar → catch → take-up → feed.
惯性力与转速平方成正比；平衡块 = 旋转质量 + k × 往复质量，示意质量下最佳 k ≈ 0.45，竖直二阶力平衡块无法抵消。
Inertia force ∝ speed²; counterweight = rotating mass + k × reciprocating mass, best k ≈ 0.45 with the illustrative masses; the vertical second order cannot be balanced by it.
降振三条路：减轻运动质量、选好平衡块、弹性隔振；润滑要可靠又不能沾油，转速上限由最先到达极限的机构决定。
Three ways to cut vibration: lighter moving parts, a good counterweight, elastic isolation; lubrication must be reliable yet oil-free on the fabric, and top speed is set by the first limit reached.

title: 全机时序编辑器
Whole-machine timing editor
goal: 体会移动一个机构的相位会怎样改变其他机构的余量。
Experience how moving one mechanism’s phase changes the margins of the others.
在实验中验证挑线相位窗口，并找出两端各由哪条判据限制。
Verify the take-up phase window and find which criterion limits each end.
通过调平衡率和转速，理解整机惯性力的平方律和平衡块的取舍。
Understand the square law of inertia force and the counterweight trade-off by adjusting balance ratio and speed.
theory: 六条判据：钩线回升 1.6–2.5 mm；钩线到脱环余量 ≥ 1 mm；针眼入布前余线 ≤ 10 mm；入布后欠线 ≤ 1 mm；布在针中移动 ≤ 0.05 mm；升牙比针尖出布晚 ≥ 20°（示意）。

Six criteria: rise at catch 1.6–2.5 mm; catch-to-cast-off margin ≥ 1 mm; slack before eye entry ≤ 10 mm; shortfall after entry ≤ 1 mm; fabric movement with needle in ≤ 0.05 mm; dog rises ≥ 20° after the needle leaves (illustrative).
数据来自第 3–6 章算例：布厚 1.5 mm、针距 3 mm、棉布；挑线轨道中供线量减耗线量为余线。
Data from the Chapter 3–6 examples: 1.5 mm fabric, 3 mm stitch, cotton; on the take-up track, supply minus consumption is the slack.
示意质量：针杆 120 g、曲柄旋转 60 g、挑线杆 25 g、牙架 50 g；平衡块 = 旋转质量 + k × 往复质量；惯性力 ∝ 转速²。
Illustrative masses: needle bar 120 g, rotating crank 60 g, take-up 25 g, feed carrier 50 g; counterweight = rotating + k × reciprocating mass; inertia force ∝ speed².
steps: 打开实验页，在标准设定下记录右侧六条判据的数值，看清时序轨道上机针、挑线、旋梭、送布四条轨道和灰色的机针在布中区间。
Open the lab and record the six criterion values at standard; identify the needle, take-up, hook and feed tracks and the grey needle-in-fabric band.
只拖动“旋梭定时”滑杆，从 −12° 到 +12°，记录回升量和钩线到脱环余量何时变红，比较两者谁先出界。

title: 全机时序与整机动力学分析
Whole-machine timing and dynamics analysis
tasks: （计算）算例中机针在布中（101.7°–258.3°）与送布牙露出针板（325.8°–114.2°）的区间重叠多少度？在 4000、5000、6000 r/min 下各是多长时间？为什么这段重叠是允许的？

(Calculation) In the worked example, by how many degrees do the needle-in-fabric (101.7°–258.3°) and dog-above-plate (325.8°–114.2°) intervals overlap? How long is that at 4000, 5000 and 6000 r/min? Why is the overlap acceptable?
（计算与分析）把旋梭定时推迟 4°（钩线约 210°），用第 3 章公式（r = 15.5 mm、连杆 55 mm）求钩线时的回升量，说明哪条判据先不满足；再结合图 8-3 解释本章开头那位师傅把旋梭推迟七八度后为什么开始断线。

(Calculation and analysis) Retard the hook by 4° (catch at about 210°). Using the Chapter 3 formula (r = 15.5 mm, rod 55 mm), find the rise at catch and say which criterion fails first; then use Fig. 8-3 to explain why the mechanic in the opening started getting thread breaks after retarding the hook seven or eight degrees.
（实验）在虚拟实验 8-1 中完成任务 3，并在 6000 r/min 下记录 k = 0、0.3、0.45、0.6、1 时的最大合力，画出“最大合力—k”曲线，与图 8-5 比较。
(Lab) Complete Task 3 of Virtual lab 8-1, and at 6000 r/min record the maximum resultant for k = 0, 0.3, 0.45, 0.6 and 1; plot maximum resultant against k and compare with Fig. 8-5.
（论述）为什么平衡块不能把平缝机的振动力消除干净？从一阶与二阶惯性力、竖直与水平方向、挑线杆的复杂运动三方面说明，并提出两条从设计上进一步减小振动的措施。

(Discussion) Why can a counterweight not remove a lockstitch machine’s shaking force completely? Explain in terms of first- and second-order forces, vertical and horizontal directions, and the take-up lever’s complex motion, and propose two design measures to reduce vibration further.

text: 机针在布中与送布牙抓布的重叠区为 101.7°–114.2°（12.5°）。主轴 4000 r/min 时这段重叠持续多少毫秒？
The needle-in-fabric and dog-gripping intervals overlap from 101.7° to 114.2° (12.5°). At 4000 r/min, how many milliseconds does the overlap last?
在一针的相位预算中，挑线杆在 55° 收线最紧时，送布牙处于什么状态？
In the phase budget of a stitch, what is the feed dog doing when the take-up lever is tightest at 55°?
还露在针板上方推布，线迹在布移动时被收紧
Still above the plate feeding, so the stitch is set while the fabric moves
在针板下面退回，布静止
Returning below the plate, the fabric at rest
正好落下，布刚停
Just dropping, the fabric just stopped
正好升出针板，开始推布
Just emerging, starting to feed

feedback: 牙抓布区间为 325.8°–114.2°，55° 落在其中；第 6 章算过此时布才走了约四分之三。
The gripping interval is 325.8°–114.2°, which contains 55°; Chapter 6 found the fabric only about three-quarters of the way at that point.

text: 算例针杆机构 r = 15.5 mm、连杆 55 mm。钩线在主轴 208° 时机针从最低点回升多少 mm？（可用第 3 章精确公式或近似式 h ≈ (r/2)(1+λ)δ²）
Worked-example needle bar r = 15.5 mm, rod 55 mm. If catch occurs at 208° of shaft, how far has the needle risen from its lowest point, in mm? (Use the exact Chapter 3 formula or h ≈ (r/2)(1+λ)δ².)
feedback: 精确计算约 2.30 mm（近似式约 2.37 mm），仍在 1.6–2.5 mm 内；超过约 209.2° 就出界。
The exact formula gives about 2.30 mm (the approximation about 2.37 mm), still within 1.6–2.5 mm; beyond about 209.2° it goes out of range.

text: 按图 8-3，旋梭定时窗口约为 −2.8° 到 +3.2°，两端的限制来自：
In Fig. 8-3 the hook-timing window is about −2.8° to +3.2°. Both ends are limited by:
钩线时机针回升量超出 1.6–2.5 mm
The needle rise at catch leaving 1.6–2.5 mm
钩线到脱环的挑线余量小于 1 mm
The catch-to-cast-off take-up margin falling below 1 mm
布在针中移动超过 0.05 mm
Fabric movement with the needle in exceeding 0.05 mm
针眼入布前余线超过挑线簧行程
Slack before eye entry exceeding the check-spring stroke

feedback: 挑线余量要推迟约 6.5° 才降到 1 mm 以下，所以算例机上先受限的是回升量；但每推迟 1° 余量少 0.1–0.2 mm。
The take-up margin drops below 1 mm only after about 6.5° of retard, so the rise limits first on this machine — though each degree costs 0.1–0.2 mm of margin.

text: 挑线曲柄安装角推迟 7°（其余标准），最先出现的问题是：
If the take-up crank is retarded by 7° (others standard), the first problem is:
针眼入布后挑线杆放线跟不上，欠线超过 1 mm
After eye entry the take-up cannot release thread fast enough; the shortfall exceeds 1 mm
针眼入布前余线超过 10 mm，挑线簧收不住
Before eye entry the slack exceeds 10 mm and the check spring cannot hold it
钩线时回升量超过 2.5 mm
The rise at catch exceeds 2.5 mm
送布牙升牙太早
The feed dog rises too early

feedback: 推迟时挑线放线滞后，+7° 欠线约 1.13 mm；提前时才是入布前余线超过挑线簧行程（−3° 时达 10 mm）。挑线相位不影响回升量。
Retarding delays the release: at +7° the shortfall is about 1.13 mm. Advancing is what makes the pre-entry slack exceed the check-spring stroke (10 mm at −3°). Take-up phase does not affect the rise.

text: 送布定时的相位窗口大致对称，推迟和提前都能各调二十度左右。
The feed-timing window is roughly symmetric, allowing about twenty degrees of retard or advance.
feedback: 很不对称：标准定时已站在“布在针中移动 0.05 mm”的边上，推迟只能约 1°；提前可到约 −47°。
Very asymmetric: standard timing already sits at the 0.05 mm edge, so only about 1° of retard is possible, while advance reaches about −47°.

text: k = 0.45 时，整机最大合力在 5000 r/min 下约 368 N。主轴降到 4500 r/min，最大合力约为多少 N？
At k = 0.45 the maximum resultant at 5000 r/min is about 368 N. At 4500 r/min, what is it, in N?
feedback: Inertia force goes with speed squared: 368 × (4500/5000)² = 368 × 0.81 ≈ 298 N. A linear scaling would give 331 N.

text: 关于平衡块和平衡率 k（平衡块 = 旋转质量 + k × 往复质量），下列说法哪些正确？
About the counterweight and balance ratio k (counterweight = rotating mass + k × reciprocating mass), which statements are correct?
k = 0 只平衡旋转部分的离心力
k = 0 balances only the centrifugal force of the rotating part
k = 1 在竖直方向抵消往复质量的一阶力，却在水平方向产生同样大小的新不平衡力
k = 1 cancels the first-order reciprocating force vertically but creates an equal new one horizontally
按本章示意质量，最好的 k 约为 0.45
With this chapter’s illustrative masses the best k is about 0.45
平衡块能抵消针杆的二阶惯性力（λ cos 2φ 项）
The counterweight can cancel the needle bar’s second-order force (the λ cos 2φ term)
加上挑线杆以后，最佳 k 从约 0.45 提高到约 0.6
Adding the take-up lever raises the best k from about 0.45 to about 0.6

feedback: 平衡块与主轴同频，只能处理一阶力；只算针杆和曲柄最佳 k 约 0.6，加上一阶偏水平的挑线杆后降到约 0.45。

The counterweight turns at shaft frequency and handles only first-order force; with needle bar and crank alone the best k is about 0.6, and adding the horizontally leaning take-up lowers it to about 0.45.

text: k = 0.45 时最大合力在 5000 r/min 下约 368 N。若要求最大合力不超过 450 N，主轴转速最高可到多少 r/min？
At k = 0.45 the maximum resultant is about 368 N at 5000 r/min. If it must not exceed 450 N, what is the highest allowable shaft speed in r/min?
feedback: n = 5000 × √(450/368) ≈ 5529 r/min，与说明书标准型最高 5500 sti/min 很接近。
n = 5000 × √(450/368) ≈ 5529 r/min, close to the manual’s 5500 sti/min for the standard type.

text: 说明书检查旋梭油量的方法是：
The manual checks the hook oil quantity by:
停机后立即把油量检查纸放在旋梭下方，看甩出的油迹宽度
Holding oil-check paper under the hook right after stopping and examining the width of the splash
看油盘油位是否在上下刻线之间
Checking that the oil-pan level is between the marks
用温度计测旋梭温度不超过规定值
Measuring the hook temperature with a thermometer
缝一块浅色布，看有没有油点
Sewing a light-coloured fabric and looking for oil spots

feedback: 油迹宽度的合适范围：薄料型约 0.5–1 mm，中厚、厚料型约 1–3 mm。查油位和试缝浅色布也要做，但不是调旋梭油量的方法。
Suitable splash widths: about 0.5–1 mm for light types, 1–3 mm for medium and heavy. Checking the pan level and test-sewing light fabric are also good practice, but not how hook oil is set.

text: 一台平缝机的主轴转速从 3000 r/min 提高到 4500 r/min，其各运动零件的惯性力增大到原来的多少倍？
A lockstitch machine’s shaft speed is raised from 3000 to 4500 r/min. By what factor do the inertia forces of its moving parts increase?
feedback: Inertia force ∝ ω²: (4500/3000)² = 1.5² = 2.25. Speed rises by only 50% but force by a factor of 2.25.

text: 算例针杆机构 r = 15.5 mm、连杆 55 mm，标准钩线在 206.07°（回升 2.0 mm）。把旋梭定时推迟 3°（主轴转角），用第 3 章精确的曲柄滑块公式求钩线时的回升量。

Worked-example needle bar r = 15.5 mm, rod 55 mm; standard catch at 206.07° (2.0 mm rise). Retard the hook timing by 3° of shaft angle and use the exact Chapter 3 slider-crank formula to find the rise at catch.
feedback: 钩线在 209.07°，回升约 2.47 mm，刚好还在 2.5 mm 以内，所以推迟窗口约为 +3.2°；推迟 4° 就到 2.63 mm。
Catch at 209.07° gives a rise of about 2.47 mm, just inside 2.5 mm, so the retard limit is about +3.2°; 4° gives 2.63 mm.

text: 设计一台平缝机时，确定各机构相位的合理顺序是：
When designing a lockstitch machine, the sensible order for fixing the phases is:
刺布 → 钩线 → 挑线 → 送布
Needle bar → catch → take-up → feed
送布 → 刺布 → 挑线 → 钩线
Feed → needle bar → take-up → catch
挑线 → 钩线 → 送布 → 刺布
Take-up → catch → feed → needle bar
钩线 → 送布 → 刺布 → 挑线
Catch → feed → needle bar → take-up

feedback: 刺布是一切定时的基准；钩线时刻由回升量定；挑线按钩线时刻和线环耗线量设计；送布放在机针出布的空档里。
The needle bar is the reference for all timing; catch is set by the rise; the take-up is designed from the catch instant and loop consumption; the feed fits the gap while the needle is out.

text: 教材提出的降低整机振动的途径有哪些？
Which routes to lower machine vibration does the book give?
减小运动零件的质量（空心针杆、轻量化挑线杆）
Reduce the mass of moving parts (hollow needle bar, lightweight take-up)
选好平衡块（平衡率）
Choose the counterweight (balance ratio) well
在机头和台板之间装弹性垫，阻断传递
Fit elastic pads between head and table to break the transmission
加大平衡块直到 k = 1
Enlarge the counterweight until k = 1
把旋梭转速比改为 1:1
Change the hook ratio to 1:1

feedback: 前两条从源头减小惯性力，第三条阻断传递路径。k = 1 会把力转到水平方向，最大合力反而约 609 N。
The first two cut force at the source and the third breaks the path. k = 1 just turns the force horizontal, giving about 609 N maximum.

text: 挑线杆在机头面板一侧、送布牙架在底板下面，它们的惯性力形成使机头摇晃的力偶，可以由针杆曲柄上的平衡块完全抵消。
The take-up lever on the face-plate side and the feed carrier under the bed produce couples that rock the head, and these can be fully cancelled by the counterweight on the needle-bar crank.
feedback: 这些力作用在不同位置，形成力偶；曲柄上的平衡块只产生一个与主轴同频的力，抵消不了这些力偶。本章模型也只算了合力，没有算力矩。

These forces act at different places and form couples; a crank counterweight produces only one force at shaft frequency and cannot cancel them. The chapter’s model computes only the resultant, not moments.

key: 全机时序图与相位预算；跨机构约束与三个相位窗口；惯性力的平方律与平衡率。
The whole-machine timing diagram and phase budget; cross-mechanism constraints and the three windows; the square law and the balance ratio.
difficult: 旋梭定时与挑线余量的联动；送布窗口为何不对称；最佳平衡率为何是 0.45 而不是 1，以及二阶力和力偶为何不能被平衡块抵消。
The coupling between hook timing and take-up margin; why the feed window is lopsided; why the best k is 0.45 not 1, and why second-order forces and couples escape the counterweight.
